### Accessibility and behavior

- Native semantic elements retain their names and content
- Billable cycle announces percentage and remaining days. Explicit progress wins over date-derived progress, except an ended period is always 100% with zero days. now is an injectable ISO clock; omission uses the current instant. Missing dates/progress produce named unavailable terms. Remaining days use ceil of the nonnegative UTC duration.

Role: `none`.
